title: Call the TBS layer across the WoW64 boundary
preconditions: a per-prefix virtual TPM is running and Wine with the mingw cross-compilers is available (dev-host gate)
steps: build the layer and the scenario harness as PE binaries for x86_64 and i686 with the winsock transport
assert the object-level symbol shapes (i386 stdcall decorations with exact argument-byte counts, x64 undecorated)
run the behavior matrix for both architectures under Wine, the i686 leg through WoW64
compare the random payloads the two architectures received
invariants: invariant 28: No raw Windows pointer or unchecked length crosses the Wine/Unix boundary.
invariant 17: Raw Windows TPM compatibility terminates at an isolated virtual TPM.
residual_risk: the PE transport is the same one-connection-per-submit model over the prefix's own sockets; the layer validates every pointer and length per the documented prototype before use, and both callers only ever reach their own prefix's vTPM; executable evidence: wine/tests/test-tbs-wow64.py
